name: gatiod-conversation-policy-data
purpose: Drive a deterministic, slot-based conversation layer for GATIOD PI% assessment.
design_principles: LLM extracts facts and proposes patches only; deterministic policy decides the next action.
No PI% is shown unless a successful assess_* calculation tool produced it.
Ask the smallest next necessary question.
Use structured state, slots, chips and response templates instead of prompt-generated flow.
Fail closed when a diagnosis, measurement, pathway, or required confirmation is missing.

source_alignment.chat_assistant_readme: RAG + deterministic engine architecture; LLM should not do math.
source_alignment.system_prompt: Existing prompt already requires confirmation, tool calling, and multi-system flow; this data externalises those rules.
source_alignment.tool_schemas: System policies map to assess_* and lookup_* tool schemas.
source_alignment.engine_index: Policies cover the 9 exported GATIOD systems plus global CVC.
